description: Turn a script into a hosted voiceover audio URL, optionally with caption cues synced to the speech. Returns { url, durationSeconds, cues? }. Then place it with neuron_studio_apply: add_audio({url, label:'Voiceover', durationSeconds}) and add_captions({cues}). This makes fully-voiced reels possible from a prompt. Needs a TTS key on the org (captions also need a transcription key).

voice.description: Voice id/name for the engine (else the org default).

withCaptions.description: Also transcribe the audio into synced caption cues.

name: neuron_studio_voiceover
title: Generate a voiceover (TTS)
